task.title: Creating the first user on a standalone registry
task.shortdesc: To create the first user account on a standalone Red Hat Quay registry, you can open the UI and complete Create Account. You can then log in from the CLI to confirm access.

ul.li: You have deployed a proof of concept, standalone, or high availability Red Hat Quay registry.
You can reach the registry UI, for example, http://quay-server.example.com.

step.cmd: Open the Red Hat Quay UI in a browser.
Enter the details for Username, Password, Email, and then click Create Account. After creating the first user, you are automatically logged in to the Project Quay registry.
